title: Free Storage Added for Insurer Re-Inspections on Repair Estimates & Appointments Statements
content:
**Rule.** Insurer re-inspections lengthen the free storage period of a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement: a booking carrying two or more estimate revisions adds **4** free storage days, a booking carrying exactly one estimate revision adds **2**, and a booking with no estimate revision adds none.

The count is of the estimate revisions recorded on the booking (each revision is a re-inspection with its own revision number).

**Questions and answers**

*How many free storage days does a booking with three revisions add?* Three is two or more, so it adds 4 free storage days — the same as a booking with exactly two.

*A booking has exactly one revision.* It adds 2 free storage days.

*No revision was ever made.* No free storage day is added under this rule.

| Estimate revisions on the booking | Free storage days added |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 4 |
| 3 or more | 4 |
